parameters.name: ClientId
parameters.description: The ID of the consumer client. You can call the [OnsConsumerGetConnection](~~29598~~) operation to query client IDs.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the consumer group. For information about what a consumer group is, see [Terms](~~29533~~).

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance to which the specified consumer group belongs.

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.description: The topic to which the message is pushed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ons ons-message-push --group-id GID_test_group_id --client-id '30.5.121.00@24813#-1999745829#-1737591554#453111174894656' --msg-id 0BC1669963053CF68F733BB703960000 --topic test-mq_topic --instance-id MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ons OnsMessagePush --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --ClientId '30.5.121.00@24813#-1999745829#-1737591554#453111174894656' --Topic 'test-mq_topic' --MsgId 0BC1669963053CF68F733BB703960000 --GroupId GID_test_group_id
